verdict.rationale: Hightouch's documented collection paths are SDKs, the HTTP Tracking API, and streaming sources like Kafka or Pub/Sub, all described as ways to instrument your own app, site, or backend. Its other 'sources' are warehouses and lakes it reads from for syncing out, and none of the evidence shows native source connectors that pull customer data from third-party cloud apps or external feeds. Ingesting from third-party SaaS would rely on the user's own warehouse pipelines, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps
